summary: A sign-in pair of TextFields: a required email and a revealable password with a Forgot password link under it, neither showing an asterisk.
use: Login and reset forms: the show/hide password eye, a link or strength meter under the field, and required fields without the asterisk when nothing is optional.
spec: Email field `type="email"` with `required` and `requiredIndicator={false}`: the input is required, the label shows no asterisk
Password field `type="password"` with `revealable`: the component renders the eye button inside the field; the demo has no local reveal state
`{#snippet below()}` renders `Forgot password?` under the field, after any error or description
